solutions.title: Full DP table
solutions.strategy: Build a table where each cell stores the best distance between two prefixes.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every pair of prefixes from the two words is evaluated once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The table stores a distance for every prefix pair.

solutions.title: Rolling rows
solutions.strategy: Keep only the previous and current DP rows, using the shorter word as the column dimension.

timeComplexity.explanation: The same prefix-pair transitions are still evaluated.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only one row for the shorter word plus the current row is stored.
